notes.message: After an unwind or a group the rows page by offset, up to offset 5000; rows written between two pages may repeat or be skipped.
A reference of 'erpLine' that resolves to nothing leaves the alias null and is reported (RESOLVE_MISSING) (onMissing report); not_found lose data.
'erpLine' is joined in the aggregate before the page is taken, for every candidate row: a later stage reads it.
'sourceLine' comes from another service; its owner binds the select, the filter and every path under the alias.

A reference of 'sourceLine' that resolves to nothing leaves the alias null and is reported (RESOLVE_MISSING) (onMissing report); ambiguous, not_found, invalid_key, owner_unanswered lose data. A key more than one record holds is always reported (RESOLVE_AMBIGUOUS).
'sourceLine' is joined after the page is taken, for the page's rows only.
'number' is not a member of the row owning 'transport.shipment#billingLines'; the owning row of 'sourceLine' carries it only for the other targets.
'shipmentNumber' is not a member of the row owning 'transport.tour#billingLines'; the owning row of 'sourceLine' carries it only for the other targets.
This resolve continues under 'sourceLine' at its owner, which binds and runs it for rows resolved to 'transport.shipment' only.

A reference of 'deliveringTour' that resolves to nothing leaves the alias null; only an owner that fails is reported (onMissing null); ambiguous, not_found, invalid_key, owner_unanswered lose data. A key more than one record holds is always reported (RESOLVE_AMBIGUOUS).
This resolve continues under 'sourceLine' at its owner, which binds and runs it for rows resolved to 'transport.shipment' only.

A reference of 'shipmentVehicle' that resolves to nothing leaves the alias null and is reported (RESOLVE_MISSING) (onMissing report); ambiguous, not_found, invalid_key, owner_unanswered lose data. A key more than one record holds is always reported (RESOLVE_AMBIGUOUS).
This resolve continues under 'sourceLine' at its owner, which binds and runs it for rows resolved to 'transport.tour' only.

A reference of 'tourVehicle' that resolves to nothing leaves the alias null and is reported (RESOLVE_MISSING) (onMissing report); ambiguous, not_found, invalid_key, owner_unanswered lose data. A key more than one record holds is always reported (RESOLVE_AMBIGUOUS).
This lookup continues under 'sourceLine' at its owner, which binds and runs it for rows resolved to 'transport.shipment' only.
